changeSet.sql: CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION [dbo].[GetAssetLevelById] ( @Id bigint ) RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN ( select ID, Segments.value('(/path/segment/@level)[last()]', 'int') as [Level] from AssetPath where ID = @id )
changeSet.rollback:
CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION [dbo].[GetAssetLevelById] ( @Id bigint ) RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN ( with c as ( select A.ID as RootID, I.ObjectAssetID as CurrentID, I.SubjectAssetID as ParentID, 1 as [Level] from Asset A left join PredicateIntersect I on I.ObjectAssetID = A.ID and I.PredicateType in (3, 4) where A.ID = @Id union all select c.RootID, c.ParentID as CurrentID, I.SubjectAssetID as ParentID, c.Level + 1 as Level from PredicateIntersect I inner join c on c.CurrentID = I.ObjectAssetID and I.PredicateType in (3, 4) )
select top 1 RootID as ID, [Level] from c order by [Level] desc )
